integrity: General formulas are proved analytically. The included exact rational verifier tests q=2..32 and independently enumerates vertices for q=2,3,4; finite checks are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Canonical normalized nonsymmetric 2-by-q family, Frobenius metric, q>=2; no higher-row, optimal ellipsoid or affine-invariance claims. The 2023 and 2026 full manuscripts were not retrievable, leaving possible hidden historical coverage; independent validation not performed.
title: A sharp outer-sphere and contact collapse for two-row Monge polytopes
